APRIL 1,202S

ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, be
amended by changing all the RS-2 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House)
District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 13-M in the area bounded

by
West Foster Avenue; North Melvina Avenue; and West Higgins Avenue;
to those of a B3-1 Community Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and

due publication.

Common Address of Property: 6200 West Higgins Avenue
